description: Two modes: range (head_branch, optionally base_branch: commits in head not in base, filtered by author/message/path) or diff (from_commit, to_commit: unified diffs between two commits).

base_branch.description: Range mode: base, excluded (default the default branch)

from_commit.description: Diff mode: from. Any commit form

head_branch.description: Range mode: head, included; setting it selects range mode

message.description: Range mode: message substring, case-insensitive (git log --grep)

name: git_diff
